source_scope: 18 selected production, ABI, adapter, test and build inputs match the Linux workspace byte-for-byte; not a hermetic whole-worktree release manifest.

execution.runtime: native root host CLI and persistent dual-stack peers in two private MTU-1500 network namespaces, one selected cgroup; selected UDP port routed to child netem queue

findings.change: Add real selected-port delay/duplication/reordering acceptance and per-socket directional-order checks. Reuse the controlled worker and native namespace/socket fixture. No product runtime change.
findings.interpretation: Request duplication adds server receives/sends; response duplication adds client receives but not server sends. Each copy is a distinct captured hook observation. Native receive inversions are retained per socket/direction; no global cross-CPU or cross-socket order is claimed.
development_attempts: attempt-1 passed before strict live queue-configuration and flower-classifier assertions; excluded from final accepted runs
findings.latency_scope: Observed first replies after deliberate 120ms delay in six bounded family/run samples, not latency percentiles, capture overhead or a general RTT benchmark.

summary_projection: Expected packet arrays and network-regression observations are omitted to avoid duplicating raw exports. Netem's unused random seed is omitted from this projection; 100% deterministic injection does not rely on it. Original summaries retain exact 64-bit seeds. SHA-256 binds original summary bytes, not this projection.

validation.clippy_command: cargo --config profile.dev.package.gewyvern.opt-level=2 clippy --locked --test production_capture_linux_tdd --test native_validation_harness_tdd -- -D warnings
validation.status_validation_scope: Catalog consistency and declared GUI target coverage, not overall product readiness.

limits: One host, private veth, deterministic targeted faults and four-packet bursts; not random jitter, congestion, physical links or sustained load.
Per-socket directional order in these runs is not global wire order across sockets, CPUs, analysis windows or hosts.
Duplicate observations remain distinct; no transaction de-duplication, exactly-once transport or automatic root-cause classifier is added.
All netem-test payloads are 32 bytes. The product's 128-byte prefix limit and run-local namespace identities remain unchanged.
No release-artifact, protocol-count or status-maturity promotion.
